events.title: Our Discord server is live! 🎉
events.summary: Hey everyone! We finally did it, the official MONADRA Discord server is open! We're a small indie team and we want to build this game together with you. Huge thanks to everyone who played the demo, left a review or made a video. We read everything you write, for real. What's on the server? • Feedback & suggestions: What did you love, what didn't click, what's missing? Tell us directly. • Bug reports: Something broke? Let us know and we'll jump on it. • Dev updates: New features, patches and behi

events.title: 200 Wishlists! Thank you, smashers!
events.summary: Hey smashers! Goblin Smasher just passed 200 wishlists and honestly we're still kind of in shock. 200 people saw a little game about smashing goblins and went "yep, I want that." That means a lot to us. Thank you to everyone who wishlisted, played the demo, left feedback or just said something nice. You got us here. events.title: Your language, polished: translation fixes in all 30 languages

events.summary: 30 languages Smash goblins in your own language. events.title: A new look, and the demo now runs on Mac
